sentences.text: Health visitor Rachel Moore confirmed the appointment is Noah's four-month check.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated that information shared during the conversation would remain confidential unless there were concerns about a child's safety, in which case she (S
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that her daughter Isla said Uncle Ryan touched her private parts (specifically her front bottom) when he babysits.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that Isla said it was a secret and told her not to tell mummy.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that Isla said this on Sunday night while she was in the bath.
Mother Gemma Shaw identified Uncle Ryan as Liam's brother who babysits on Fridays when Gemma is at work and Liam is on nights, a practice that has been ongoing since September.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that her sister Kelly said Ryan was in trouble years ago with the police, but Kelly did not know what it was and only heard it from someone at her work,
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she had to share the disclosure with children's social care (Harbridge MASH) due to what Isla said.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated that the children's social care would not take the children off Gemma Shaw because she had done what a protective parent does.
Health visitor Rachel Moore instructed Gemma Shaw to ensure Ryan does not babysit or have any time alone with Isla or Noah until the situation is looked into.
Mother Gemma Shaw confirmed that Ryan is not coming near the children.
Health visitor Rachel Moore instructed Gemma Shaw not to confront Ryan herself and to leave that to the police.
Health visitor Rachel Moore instructed Gemma Shaw to ask Liam to wait before going to Ryan's house, noting that it could make things harder for Isla.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated that Gemma Shaw is managing financially with Liam's wages from the warehouse, Gemma's Co-op money, and child benefit.
Mother Gemma Shaw reported that she has not been sleeping since Sunday.
Health visitor Rachel Moore agreed to ring Gemma Shaw by four o'clock to tell her what the children's social care said.
Health visitor Rachel Moore agreed to ring Gemma Shaw to discuss the children's social care outcome.
Health visitor Rachel Moore agreed to ring the Harbridge MASH as soon as she left the appointment.
Health visitor Rachel Moore instructed Gemma Shaw to ask her mother about looking after the children on Fridays.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she would write to Dr Kaur today.
Health visitor Rachel Moore stated she would see Gemma Shaw and Noah next Wednesday, the second of December.
